method: Inspected 12 evenly spaced native frames per camera, including start and final; every video frame was decoded separately. Sampled visual review, not a claim to have watched every frame.
observations: Front shows the complete tray, loose carcass, both arms and three successive plucks.
The final breast has no attached feather groups; loose feathers remain inside the tray.
Both hands withdraw after the last extraction and the carcass stays breast-up inside the tray.
Rear is occluded by grippers during work; side crops the far end. Use the complete front recording.
No team-identifying text or overlays are visible.
scoring_note: The final carcass is visibly inside the tray. The pure mesh-floor scoring correction is separately audited; damage and release checks are unchanged.
